name: Blind Date
source:
Okay, beanface. Take a breath. Close your eyes for a second. You've got a blind date tonight. You've got this! It's gonna be simple: show up, chew your food like a gentleman, laugh, try not to spittle, have a good time, who knows what's gonna happen next.

But.. what if she thinks you're ugly? Or your breath smells, or she figured out about that mole? Or you say something really embarrassing or you dribble something on your shirt? What if the food at the restaurant is too fancy and she laughs at the way you can't pronounce acaí? What if you can't think of anything to talk about? What if everything goes horribly wrong and you end up in a gulag in some foreign country?

Or... what if it goes well, you laugh, share a few drinks?

Life's a constantly evolving, unfolding series of possibilities. You got this. You can do it. And heck, if everything goes sideways, you can always try again...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1014420/Blind_Date/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
好吧，豆脸。吸一口气。闭上眼睛一会儿。今晚你有个相亲。你已经得到了这个！一切都很简单：出现，像绅士一样咀嚼食物，大笑，尽量不要吐口水，玩得开心，谁知道接下来会发生什么。

但是..如果她认为你丑怎么办？或者你的呼吸有味道，或者她发现了那颗痣？或者你说了一些非常尴尬的话或者你把什么东西滴到了你的衬衫上？如果餐厅的食物太精致而她嘲笑你不会发音巴西莓怎么办？如果你想不出有什么可聊的怎么办？如果一切都出了严重问题，你最终被关进某个外国的古拉格怎么办？

或者……如果进展顺利，你们笑了，一起喝了几杯怎么办？

生命是一个不断发展、不断展开的一系列可能性。你得到了这个。你可以做到的。哎呀，如果一切都不顺利，你随时可以再试一次……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1014420/Blind_Date/]Steam[/url]]
